details: A one-stop solution for multiple scholarships from Central Government, State Governments, and UTs. Provides a common platform for application and disbursement via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
benefits: Multiple scholarships ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000+ per year; Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to bank accounts.

eligibility.text: Indian citizen; School or college student; Merit or income based eligibility depending on the specific scholarship.

details: Financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefits: ₹10,000 per year for graduation; ₹20,000 per year for post-graduation.

eligibility.text: Students in the top 20th percentile in Class 12; Pursuing regular higher education; Family income below ₹8 lakh per annum.

details: A flagship program to address the declining Child Sex Ratio and promote empowerment of girls through education and health.
benefits: Education support; Healthcare access; Community awareness programs and incentives for girl children.

eligibility.text: All girl children in India; Implemented through coordinated efforts in schools and community centers.

details: Provides loans to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises to encourage entrepreneurship and self-employment.
benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh (Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun categories) without collateral.

eligibility.text: Indian citizen; Small business owner or micro-entrepreneur with a viable business plan.

details: The world's largest health insurance/assurance scheme fully financed by the government. Provides cashless access to healthcare services.
benefits: ₹5 lakh health insurance coverage per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

eligibility.text: Based on economic criteria from Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC); Must be in the eligible beneficiary list.

details: An initiative to empower the youth of the country with skill sets which make them more employable and more productive in their work environment.
benefits: Free skill training across various sectors; Industry-recognized certification; Job placement support.

eligibility.text: Indian youth; Minimum educational requirements vary by course.
